build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance to manage distributed data parallel training across multiple GPUs
run_Trainer_train_step: run a training step with forward pass, backward pass, and parameter update on samples
save_Trainer_checkpoint: save the full training state including model, optimizer, and EMA to a checkpoint file
load_Trainer_checkpoint: load training state from a checkpoint file and restore model, optimizer, and learning rate
run_Trainer_valid_step: run a validation step performing a forward pass in evaluation mode on a sample
